title: Kubernetes from Zero
description: Kubernetes from the first container to a production cluster, one part a day.
heroAlt: Paper-cut wooden-brown ship's helm behind a slate-blue control-plane tray with a cream manifest and four modules, worker nodes with cream and coral crates on a navy cluster map and a coral return loop
audience: People starting with Kubernetes: a junior DevOps engineer, a developer who deploys their own service, or anyone who has run docker run and wants the next step.

How to start a cluster on a laptop and follow one kubectl apply through the control plane.
The path from a first container toward a production cluster, one part at a time.
